Isolate the power supply feeding the cards
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray
Test the cables of each line
Clean the junction boxes collecting the cables with a blower
If a cable is found damaged, replace it with a new cable
Measure the line voltage and check that it is -48 V DC, via the terminal block in the box
If there is no -48 V DC, perform a reset via the CPU 545 card
If there is still no -48 V DC after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings.

Procedures to be Carried Out
Test the input and output voltages of the power supply and check that they are as follows: Input: 220 V AC. Output: (+ 12, + 5.15, 5.1, - 48) Vdc | 1.
Isolate the power supply feeding the cards | 2.
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray | 3.
Reinsert the cards | 4.
Test the cables of each line | 5.
Clean the junction boxes collecting the cables with a blower | 6.
If a cable is found damaged, replace it with a new cable | 7.
Reconnect the power supply | 8.
Measure the line voltage and check that it is -48 V DC, via the terminal block in the box | 9.
If there is no -48 V DC, perform a reset via the CPU 545 card | 10.
If there is still no -48 V DC after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings. | 11.
